prompt: Create a cute Q-version sticker-style illustration in PNG format with a transparent background (show it on a gray-and-white checkerboard transparency preview). The subject is exactly 2 Shiba Inu dogs standing side by side, full body, facing forward, happy and friendly: the left dog is a black-and-tan Shiba Inu wearing a bright orange-red chest harness with small black and yellow straps and a white curved logo mark; the right dog is a cream-white Shiba Inu wearing a black chest harness with a white curved logo mark. Keep their individual pet features recognizable: upright triangular ears, curled fluffy tails, thick plush fur, round glossy eyes, open smiling mouths, visible pink tongues, small paws, and compact Shiba body proportions. Use a polished digital illustration style with soft realistic fur texture, clean cutout edges, subtle shadows under the feet, bright cheerful expression, and a high-resolution transparent PNG sticker look. Do not add text, background scenery, extra animals, collars beyond the harnesses, or props.

promptZh: 创作一张可爱的 Q 版贴纸风格插图，格式为 PNG，背景透明（在灰白相间的透明度预览图上展示）。主体为两只并排站立的柴犬，全身照，面向前方，表情快乐友好：左侧的狗为 黑褐色 柴犬，佩戴明亮的 橙红色 胸背带，带有黑色和黄色小带子以及白色弧形标志；右侧的狗为 奶油白色 柴犬，佩戴 黑色 胸背带，带有白色弧形标志。保持它们各自的宠物特征，使其易于辨认：直立的三角形耳朵、卷曲的蓬松尾巴、厚实的毛发、圆润有光泽的眼睛、张开的笑脸、可见的粉色舌头、小爪子以及紧凑的柴犬体型比例。采用精致的数字插画风格，具有柔和逼真的毛发质感、干净的剪裁边缘、脚下细微的阴影、明快愉悦的表情，以及高分辨率的透明 PNG 贴纸外观。不要添加文字、背景风景、额外的动物、胸背带以外的项圈或道具。
